description: Optionally validate parameters or obtain a zero-cost quote when inputs are uncertain, a current quote is needed for a budget decision, or preflight is explicitly requested. Probe is not required before Call, never executes the capability, and does not reserve a price or grant authorization. Schema and quote are implemented; coverage and sample may return an explicit unknown verdict.

checks.description: Probe checks to request. Schema and quote are implemented; coverage and sample may be unknown.

live_budget.description: Probe budget. Probe does not execute the capability or consume credits.

sub_user_id.description: End-user identity for provider OAuth; use the same value for Probe and Call.

tool_id.description: Capability ID to validate without executing it.

name: probe
